notes.title: Waking Violet is out now!
notes.notes:
Do you like classic top down puzzle games? Do you like classics like Adventures of Lolo but with modern twists? Then Waking Violet is made for you!

Slide blocks around and use amazing spells to solve over 40 levels of intricate puzzles. And if you get stuck... you can rewind time and try again!

And for one week only you can get the game for a nice 30% discount - so under 5 bucks. A true bargain!
